confidence_notes: Numbeo's October 2026 Cabo panel (92 entries from 9 contributors in the prior 12 months) anchors meals, cappuccino and draft beer. The cocktail estimate is corroborated by a limited-data local price panel; wine by the glass is less certain and inferred at roughly three times local draft beer. Accommodation is holistic and has the widest uncertainty; no live booking listings were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used; food and drink rely on Cabo-specific prices, while lodging reflects general knowledge of this high-demand Baja resort destination.
